summary.content:
Today's selection covers 61 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 43 on Artificial Intelligence and 9 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Champion ethical hacker warns AI tools like Mythos could put her out of business
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: 7-Eleven data breach exposes personal information of 185,000 people
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, The Verge, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek, NY Times Tech and others
• **Fresh Content**: 41 articles published in the last 24 hours
